subject: general
question: Identify the INCORRECT pair.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Blossom Shower - Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Blossom Shower, also known as Pre-monsoon showers, is primarily associated with the state of Kerala and parts of Karnataka, not Andhra Pradesh.
 
• These showers occur in the months of March and April, marking the transition period before the onset of the southwest monsoon.
 
• This phenomenon is crucial for the growth of crops such as coffee and spices in Kerala and Karnataka.
 
• The showers help in the blossoming of coffee flowers, which is why they are also referred to as 'Coffee Showers'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nor'westers**

 
 
• Known locally as 'Kalbaisakhi', these are violent thunderstorms occurring in West Bengal and parts of Bangladesh during the pre-monsoon months of April and May.
 
• They are characterized by strong winds, heavy rain, and sometimes hail.
 
• These storms are vital for the cultivation of jute and rice in the region.
 
 
 
• **Bordoichila**
 
 
• Bordoichila is a local thunderstorm occurring in Assam during the pre-monsoon season, typically in late April to early May.
 
• These storms are named after the mythical Assamese bride 'Bordoichila' who is believed to visit her mother’s home during this time.
 
• They bring heavy rain and strong winds, which are important for tea cultivation in Assam.
 
 
 
• **Mango Showers**
 
 
• Mango showers are pre-monsoon showers that occur in parts of South India, including Kerala and Karnataka.
 
• These rains are crucial for the ripening of mangoes, hence the name 'Mango Showers'.
 
• They usually occur from March to May and provide relief from the summer heat.
